issues.reason: Sylph Small size already handled by global rules; fly speed 40 feet (poor) distinct from land 20.
Improved Flight changes movement without officially replacing Base Speed; unresolved to avoid incorrect 40/60 or 20/10 speeds.
Fey Magic has 1/day and 3/week usage, not all daily.
Heritage table header calls alternate skills but table specifies alternate spell-like abilities; use spell wording and block manual.
Fast healing trigger and per-day cap after lightning, spell resistance 6+level versus 11+level require rules runtime review.

features.name: Ability Score Racial Traits
features.description: +2 DEX, +2 CHA, -4 STR

features.name: Size
features.description: small size; global size modifiers apply only once.

features.name: Type
features.description: fey (sylph).

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: 20 ft land and 40 ft fly (poor maneuverability).

features.name: Languages
features.description: Begins speaking Sylvan and Common. High-INT choices: Elvaan, Mandragoran, Mithran, Vieran.

features.name: Elemental Resistance
features.description: Lightning resistance 5.

features.name: Magic Resistant
features.description: +1 saves against spells or spell-like effects.

features.name: Spell Resistance, Lesser
features.description: Spell resistance 6 + character level.

features.name: Beguiling Liar
features.description: +4 Bluff only to convince others of a lie.

features.name: Camouflage
features.description: +2 Stealth in wooded Black Shroud terrain.

features.name: Fey Magic
features.description: +1 DC of illusion spells; Hidden Presence SLA 1/day; Charm, Lesser Confusion, Sleep each 3/week; caster level is character level, spell DC from CHA.

features.name: Low-Light Vision
features.description: See twice as far in dim light.

features.name: Breeze-Kissed
features.description: Controllable +2 AC versus nonmagical ranged attacks, swift toggle. 1/day wind bull rush/trip at 30 ft, exhausts AC benefit for 24 hours.

features.name: Dirty Trickster
features.description: +2 dirty trick CMB and waive INT feat prerequisites for specified dirty trick feats.

features.name: Fey Damage Resistance
features.description: DR 5/cold iron.

features.name: Improved Flight
features.description: Fly speed rises 40->60 ft, land speed decreases 20->10 ft, maneuverability improves two steps. Listed replacements omit movement feature; cannot auto apply.

features.name: Inquisitive
features.description: +2 Disable Device and Escape Artist.

features.name: Spell Resistance, Greater
features.description: Spell resistance 11 + character level.

features.name: Storm in the Blood
features.description: Fast healing 2 for 1 round whenever taking lightning damage even if resisted; 2 HP/level/day cap.

features.name: Tempered
features.description: Wind resistance 5.

features.name: Whispering Wind
features.description: +4 racial Stealth.

features.name: Fairy Heritage Ability Scores
features.description: +2 CHA, +2 DEX, -2 CON, -2 STR

features.name: Fairy Heritage Benefit
features.description: Fey Magic replacement SLAs: Blur 1/day, Charm/Hypnotism/Sleep each 3/week.

features.name: Pixie Heritage Ability Scores
features.description: +2 DEX, +2 CHA, -4 CON

features.name: Pixie Heritage Benefit
features.description: Fey Magic replacement SLAs: Vanish 1/day, Charm/Sleep/Ventriloquism each 3/week.

features.name: Sprite Heritage Ability Scores
features.description: +2 DEX, +2 INT, -4 STR

features.name: Sprite Heritage Benefit
features.description: Fey Magic replacement SLAs: Seducer's Eyes 1/day, Charm/Charm Animal/Sleep each 3/week.

alternateReplacements.description: Fey Damage Resistance replaces Magic Resistant, Spell Resistance, Lesser.

Whispering Wind replaces Camouflage, Beguiling Liar.
